name: Can I install backsplash tile myself, or should I hire a pro?

mainEntity.name: Can I install backsplash tile myself, or should I hire a pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should choose a pro if the wall is uneven, the layout has lots of outlets, or you want a clean finish with tight grout lines. In homes around Greenwood Village, Parker, and Centennial, older walls can also make professional prep more important.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY can work for small, simple jobs, but a pro is better for uneven walls, tricky cuts, or custom tile patterns. Professional prep usually gives a cleaner, longer-lasting result.
